 See what the stars have in store for your sign By Snehaa Khanna Sahgal 26 October 2026 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) Your mind can turn one uncertain moment into an entire catalogue of worst-case scenarios, Aquarius . Thanks to tonight’s full moon, it may be worth treading carefully and remaining vigilant. Not every fear is a premonition, just as not every intuitive hit is a product of anxiety. When anxiety creeps in, give yourself a moment to feel without letting your feelings dictate your next move. Guidance that keeps returning from within is usually your intuition, whereas fear tends to change its message with every situation. Look at things clearly, separate facts from fears and remember who you are beyond this temporary uncertainty. Stop second-guessing yourself. You do not need to have everything figured out to show up with confidence.
 Cosmic tip: Make your life feel like it is worth believing in.
